run_BenchmarkReducer_reduce: run the BenchmarkReducer reduce method to join results, compute metrics, and log them
create_JsonDFReducer_join_results: create a JsonDFReducer to join multiple JSON result files into a single pandas DataFrame
compute_JsonDFReducer_metrics: compute mean absolute error and cosine similarity metrics from benchmark results using JsonDFReducer
save_JsonDFReducer_results: save joined benchmark results as a compressed JSON file using JsonDFReducer save_results
load_JsonDFReducer_targets: load target benchmark data from a JSON file into a sorted pandas DataFrame using load_targets
